why: All three checks pass, so the divergence stands. (1) QUOTE VERBATIM: curl -sL https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-review.md (363 lines) has the sentence exactly at line 316: 'When Claude fixes reported findings later in the session, it reports them again, and Claude Code marks each finding in the new list as fixed, skipped, or no change needed.' It is a one-sentence paragraph -- no second half that reverses it. It sits two paragraphs after the ReportFindings paragraph ('When the host application requests it, Claude reports the review's findings through the ReportFindings tool ... Claude Code renders the report as a findings list'), so 'reports them again' means a second ReportFindings call. (2) CITED FILE CONFIRMED: packages/session-tools-core/src/tool-defs.ts:269-281 -- FindingSchema is exactly {file, summary, failureScenario, category?} and ReportFindingsSchema is {findings: array(1..100)}. No outcome/state field. grep -a for no_change_needed / noChangeNeeded / 'no change needed' over packages+apps (excluding dist) returns ZERO hits; the only 'outcome' hits in session-tools-core are the sibling task-tool subsystem (DocumentedTaskOutcome, tasks/documented-tasks.ts) and a local helper fn in handlers/push-notification.ts:79 -- unrelated, exactly as the finding said. The absence is load-bearing twice over: z.object() strips unknown keys, and handlers/report-findings.ts:63-68 re-projects ONLY the four fields onto structuredContent, so a model that emitted an outcome would have it dropped silently. (3) NOT A DOC MISREADING: the sentence credits the marking to 'Claude Code', which could in principle be host-inferred, but 'skipped' vs 'no change needed' is a model-intent distinction no host can derive from a diff. Corroborated directly: the live Claude Code ReportFindings tool definition in this very session carries outcome as enum [fixed, skipped, no_change_needed] with description 'Set ONLY when re-reporting after applying fixes: what happened to this finding'. So it is a model-supplied field, not host bookkeeping. (4) NOT AN OWNER DECISION: none of the nine dated decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 touches ReportFindings (they are SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, listSessionSummaries/listSessions). ONE CORRECTION TO THE FINDING'S CONSEQUENCE: 'the host cannot render fixed/skipped/no-change' is true but mis-attributed. Nothing in this fork renders findings AT ALL -- no renderer component reads structuredContent, recorded in the R27a close-out ('What renders ReportFindings today: Nothing') and in audit row R27 ('Nothing renders either result today'), and there is no /code-review command, no --fix/--comment, no background review flow. So adding outcome changes nothing user-visible today; the divergence is contract-level (the wire payload cannot express the state), not a broken UI.
correctedState: CONFIRMED, and the gap is wider than claimed. FindingSchema (packages/session-tools-core/src/tool-defs.ts:269-276) accepts only {file, summary, failureScenario, category?}; z.object strips anything else and handlers/report-findings.ts:63-68 re-projects only those four, so a re-report after fixes is byte-identical in shape to the first report and cannot carry per-finding state. Claude's live ReportFindings tool carries, beyond those four, an outcome enum [fixed, skipped, no_change_needed] ('Set ONLY when re-reporting after applying fixes') plus line, short_summary, verdict [CONFIRMED, PLAUSIBLE] and a top-level level -- none of which tools-reference.md:45 documents either, which is why our schema, derived from that one line, has none of them. The user-visible consequence is currently nil, not 'the host cannot render': this fork renders no findings list at all (no renderer reads structuredContent; R27a close-out and audit row R27 both state this) and ships no /code-review command, so the defect is a wire-contract gap that will bite whenever a findings surface is built. code-review.md is coverage-map row 95, still unverdicted with no plan.
